parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1255131. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, exact standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
